description: This file contains asynchronous orchestration logic for managing certification jobs, including triggering Airflow DAGs, monitoring their status, updating database records, and logging audit information. It defines internal functions for retrying operations, updating job statuses, marking results as running or terminal, polling DAG runs, and a public interface 'orchestrate_job' for initiating the process.

methods.name: _with_retries(coro_fn, attempts: int, backoff: float, base_delay: float = 0.5)
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous callable with exponential backoff retries, handling exceptions and delaying retries accordingly.

methods.name: Optional[str] _dag_id_for_type(cert_type: CertificationType)
methods.description: Retrieves the Airflow DAG ID associated with a given certification type from settings.

methods.name: None _update_job_status(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob)
methods.description: Updates the overall certification job status based on the statuses of individual result entries.

methods.name: None _save_dag_run_info(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob, cert_type: CertificationType, dag_run_id: str)
methods.description: Saves the DAG run ID and DAG ID into the metrics of the relevant certification result for traceability.

methods.name: None _mark_running(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob, cert_type: CertificationType)
methods.description: Marks a specific certification result as 'running' and logs the transition via audit.

methods.name: None _mark_terminal(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob, cert_type: CertificationType, success: bool, logs_url: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Marks a certification result as 'passed' or 'failed' with optional logs URL, updates overall job status, and logs via audit.

methods.name: None _poll_one(session_factory, job_run_id: str, cert_type: CertificationType, dag_id: str, dag_run_id: str)
methods.description: Polls a specific DAG run until it completes, then updates the certification result accordingly.

methods.name: None orchestrate_job(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob)
methods.description: Public interface to trigger Airflow DAGs for each certification type associated with a job, start polling, and handle failures.
